statistical_primary.name: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics — Census 2023 District Tables
statistical_primary.scope: District-level population, area, density and related census fields.
statistical_primary.rule: Use the district table when the page describes a district; do not substitute a major-city population for a district population.

editorial_rule: Every statistical value published by MyBook.Pk should identify its geographic unit and year. If a current official figure cannot be verified, show that limitation instead of inventing an estimate.
